note: The question about infinitely many Lucas primes is a natural consequence of Édouard Lucas's foundational work on Lucas sequences published in 1878 (Théorie des Fonctions Numériques Simplement Périodiques, American Journal of Mathematics, Vol. 1), but the specific year when this open question was first formally posed or explicitly stated as a conjecture is not documented in available sources. The conjecture appears to have emerged implicitly from Lucas's work and related investigations into prime terms in recurrence sequences, but no single explicit posing of the problem is attributed in the literature.
